Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Cavaliers.

analyst.text: Memphis are 7-0 on the road and have won four of five, but leading scorer Ty Jerome sat Monday with a sore hip and GG Jackson needs surgery on a broken foot. Cleveland have finished what Yahoo called a brutal early schedule with Donovan Mitchell scoring 39 against Chicago, but Evan Mobley will miss at least another 7-10 days with a sprained toe. Jerome's status is the swing; the angle is close to neutral with a slight lean to Memphis.
